description: Editorial venue watchlist for AI, attention, communication, HCI, cognition, work and education. Not a journal-impact-factor ranking or an assessment of individual papers.

Psychology and cognition: Journal of Experimental Psychology: Human Perception and Performance
Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition
HCI and computing: Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
Proceedings of the ACM on Human-Computer Interaction
ACM Conference on Computer-Supported Cooperative Work and Social Computing
Proceedings of the ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency
Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society
Education and learning: Journal of Computing in Higher Education
Organizations and information systems: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
Journal of the Association for Information Science and Technology

Relevant interdisciplinary and field jou: Computers in Human Behavior: Artificial Humans

policies.priority: Established field venue and strong topical match: eligible for default research library, with evidence-level caveats.
policies.specialist: Recognized specialized or multidisciplinary venue and strong topical match: eligible with appropriate caution.
policies.review: Venue or publication status not yet verified, or only weak topical relevance: held in internal discovery pending editorial validation.
policies.preprint: Preprint or repository deposit, not automatically peer reviewed: review first and never imply journal validation.
policies.excluded: Clear mismatch with human attention/cognition or other program focus: do not publish as substantive research.
policies.editorial: Editorially verified primary scholarly work can be included with explicit evidence-type and reading-depth labels.
